0022600085.text: Both the Atlanta Hawks and Orlando Magic are opening their 2026-27 seasons, and the Hawks are the visitors in this first game of their year. Atlanta won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 130-101 regular-season win in Orlando on April 1, 2026. The Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the Magic are missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring), with Anthony Black, Franz Wagner, Jase Richardson and Jonathan Isaac listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Atlanta a 45% chance to win.
